about.title: A diwan for precious stones
about.lead: Planet of Gemstones began with a simple belief: a natural stone is a small piece of the earth that carries a story — and it should be chosen with care.
about.p1: In Arabic, a diwan is a gathering place — a court of poetry, a room where people meet. Our diwan is a home for precious stones and the people who love them, near Riad El Solh in the heart of Beirut.
about.p2: Every amethyst, citrine, turquoise and lapis we use is hand-picked for its colour and character. We pair them with fine gold chains and sterling silver, and we match them to your zodiac sign, your intentions and your style.
about.p3: What started as a small Instagram shop has grown into a community of more than 108,000 stone lovers across Lebanon and beyond. Thank you for letting our stones be part of your story.
